[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or program of your choice) to choose your desired color (default is Fiery Blossoms). Alternatively, use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your choice in-game.﻿
4. Load up your game and enjoy!
